name: Vasilisa
source:
A puppeteer and hero raised in the fairy realm who has trouble talking to humans. Her special skill is ventriloquism.

Her dolls names are: Guchu Ana Deluxe (Red) / Punyu Churyu Perorin (Yellow) / Crying Sticky Transfer Student (Blue)

"pucha! Don't bully Vasilisa, jupo!"
